funding.external_prerequisite: Owner must retain the original funding-wallet recovery material. MetaMask bridge-recipient history does not prove that this substrate signer exists in its encrypted keyring; that indivisible unrelated vault is excluded.

transaction_preservation_audit.scope: Selected historical local receipt, journal, pending and budget JSON; preservation audit only, not a new chain reconciliation.
other_record_classification: One has alternate expired-without-inclusion era proof
One is explicitly marked expired-unincluded in its old receipt
One historical receipt has only an InBlock phase locally; exact outcome requires fresh reconciliation before any attempted replay

source_cutoffs.base_capture_consistency: Each source file read with pre/post stability checks; SQLite uses backup API. This local archive is not a globally atomic host snapshot.

dependencies.binary_artifacts: Current host/runtime packages and immutable images are separate artifacts; source preservation alone does not prove they are available.
dependencies.pawns_runtime_note: The current Pawns implementation requires Wine10, QEMU and the exact Pawns DLL/runtime; these three official packages were preserved separately. No installation or client launch was performed.

qemu_audit.current_pawns_binary_preserved_in: Runtime supplement nested PacketStream meter-v1.tar.gz; capture_aws independently verified actual bytes/hash and accompanying libraries/plugin.
qemu_audit.source_behavior: Current Pawns prepare.py initially writes /usr/bin wrappers, then replaces them before execution with the pinned PacketStream meter QEMU wrappers.

external_prerequisites: Owner GitHub access to the private repository and private release assets; no added backup encryption key
Replacement Linux host with sufficient disk/architecture and reviewed machine-specific paths
Owner funding-wallet recovery material, separately retained
Fresh rental funds and current on-chain availability for expired leases
Fresh physical process/identity/IP evidence and transaction reconciliation before adoption or relaunch
limitations: No live replacement-host activation, new phone provisioning or duplicate earning client was tested.
Exact rented phones and IPs are not guaranteed after leases expire.
Hash verification demonstrates preserved bytes, not current provider credit or current lease health.
